name: @funcd-dev/example-blob-object
description: A funcd blob example (ADR-0127): a function that put/get/lists objects NATIVELY via context.blob (bind-as-grant, no S3 keypair). Authored in TypeScript against @funcd-dev/shim; vite build (@funcd-dev/vite-plugin) bundles it to a self-contained object.mjs; the I/O contract lives in funcdctl.yaml.
